meta.name: BOB exit-only: BOB CCIP pool
meta.description: Run after the Ethereum batch, once no Ethereum-to-BOB CCIP message is in flight. 1) changeAdmin(0xe931f1ac...) on the BurnFromMintTokenPool proxy: the Safe is the proxy admin today, so its owner calls cannot reach the pool. 0xe931f1ac is the 24h TimelockController (this Safe proposes, executes and cancels). 2) setChainRateLimiterConfig(Ethereum 5009297550715157269, outbound {disabled}, inbound {enabled, capacity 2, rate 1}): blocks new mints on BOB; BOB-to-Ethereum exits stay unlimited.
